payload.name: Broaden retrieval for off-skill career goals
payload.description: When a question asks about a person's career goals explicitly excluding their primary professional skill or domain (e.g., 'not related to his main skill', 'aspirations outside his field'), use this to broaden retrieval.
content: When a question asks about goals or aspirations explicitly outside a person's primary skill or domain (e.g., 'not related to', 'outside', 'beyond' that skill), do not restrict memory_kinds to profile/state; include preference, event, and plan, because off-skill ambitions like endorsements, charity, and business ventures are stored there.

Add query variations that name concrete off-skill goal categories such as endorsements, brand building, charity, community work, or side ventures, and run at least one search for those terms instead of only rewording the question.
Stop as soon as retrieved memories cover the distinct goal categories mentioned in the question, or after two searches with the broader kinds/terms; do not list every possible goal.

solves: Retrieval misses goals stored outside profile/state when a question contrasts a person's main skill with other career goals, because the agent restricts memory kinds and only paraphrases the question. Applies to future questions phrased as 'goals not related to X' or 'aspirations outside X' for any person/domain. Does not apply when the question concerns the main skill itself or when the goals are already captured in profile/state.
